title: 月之暗面 Kimi K3.1 Pro 上线 OpenRouter，1M 上下文多模态开源权重模型
summary: OpenRouter 宣布月之暗面的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 上线，定位为基于 Kimi K3 后训练、面向长程编码和智能体任务的 1M 上下文多模态开源权重模型。定价为 $2/M input tokens、$10/M output tokens，可在 OpenRouter 直接试用。

title: Kling 4.0 在 fal 上线并向所有客户开放 API 访问
summary: fal 宣布 Kling 4.0 正式向公众开放，所有客户均可通过 API 访问。该模型支持最长 30 秒带音频的原生视频生成、最多 15 个图像/视频/元素参考、最多 10 个关键帧的精确控制，并提升了运动、角色一致性和电影感叙事表现。

title: Anthropic 介绍 Claude Duet 智能体的安全、隐私与凭证隔离设计
summary: Anthropic 发文介绍处于研究预览阶段的 Claude Duet 智能体的安全与隐私设计。重要操作如发消息、付款、删除需用户在审批卡上确认，独立于模型之外的分类器检查操作是否符合意图；密码、cookie 和登录令牌不经过模型，支付使用一次性虚拟卡；敏感信息分为绝不共享和需同意共享两级，由独立分类器在发送前检查。

title: Claude 网页、桌面和移动端将默认启用 auto mode
summary: Claude 官方宣布，下周起 Pro、Max 和 Team 套餐在 Claude 网页、桌面和移动端应用中的会话将默认以 auto mode 运行。auto mode 不再逐步请求用户批准，而是由自动检查拦截高风险操作，用户可随时切回手动模式。其引用的 Claude Code 更新提到 auto mode 用独立分类器审查 shell 命令，测试中拦截了 89% 的危险命令，手动批准为 14%。

title: OpenAI 正式发布 Decisions API，面向低延迟低成本小决策
summary: OpenAI 宣布基于 GPT-6 Luna 的 Decisions API 正式可用，用于分类、路由、评分等有界答案问题，速度最高比通过 Responses API 使用 GPT-6 Luna 快 10x。
source: OpenAI：官网动态（RSS · 排除企业/客户案例）

title: A founder with a tool is not a founder with a clue
Can you take AI at its word?
summary: AI agents explain their own work fluently, and sometimes wrongly. Designers stopped trusting that kind of account from people long ago.

title: Design v ADHD
summary: ADHD is a complex and common mental disorder which changes how the person processes information, behaves, and functions in society. Common recommendations for “ADHD-friendly design” include reducing clutter, avoiding distractions, and simplifying information architecture. I argue that these suggestions do not constitute “ADHD-friendly design”, and that the real solution is more sophisticated and challenging, if not impossible, to implement.

title: Let AI have the average user: Why User Research should focus on bad days
summary: Nn/g found that synthetic research captures common responses. The bad days are still up to you.

title: Embracing Playful Imperfection With The CSS `random()` Function
summary: Design systems thrive on consistency, so where does randomness fit in? Through playful demos of organic typography, bouncing letters, and splayed cards, Brecht De Ruyte shows how the new CSS `random()` function brings a little imperfection to the web without JavaScript libraries or preprocessor loops that generate hundreds of lines of static CSS.
